sn35.114:1.1: “Bhikkhus, there are forms cognizable by the eye that are desirable, lovely, agreeable, pleasing, sensually enticing, tantalizing.
sn35.114:1.2: If a bhikkhu seeks delight in them, welcomes them, and remains holding to them,
sn35.114:1.3: he is called a bhikkhu who has entered Mara’s lair, who has come under Mara’s control; Mara’s snare has been fastened to him
sn35.114:1.4: so that he is bound by the bondage of Mara and the Evil One can do with him as he wishes.
sn35.114:2.1: “There are, bhikkhus, sounds cognizable by the ear …
sn35.114:3.1: mental phenomena cognizable by the mind that are desirable, lovely, agreeable, pleasing, sensually enticing, tantalizing.
sn35.114:3.2: If a bhikkhu seeks delight in them … …
sn35.114:3.4: the Evil One can do with him as he wishes.
sn35.114:4.1: “There are, bhikkhus, forms cognizable by the eye that are desirable, lovely, agreeable, pleasing, sensually enticing, tantalizing.
sn35.114:4.2: If a bhikkhu does not seek delight in them, does not welcome them, and does not remain holding to them,
sn35.114:4.3: he is called a bhikkhu who has not entered Mara’s lair, who has not come under Mara’s control; Mara’s snare has been unfastened from him
sn35.114:4.4: so that he is not bound by the bondage of Mara and the Evil One cannot do with him as he wishes.
sn35.114:5.1: “There are, bhikkhus, sounds cognizable by the ear …
sn35.114:6.1: mental phenomena cognizable by the mind that are desirable, lovely, agreeable, pleasing, sensually enticing, tantalizing.
sn35.114:6.2: If a bhikkhu does not seek delight in them …
sn35.114:6.4: the Evil One cannot do with him as he wishes.”
